name: Restore Power — Unreal C++ Quest Sample

6c069694-7fea-4980-b59d-d9dc2c857cc4.content:
RESTORE POWER · ONE PLAYABLE QUEST

Start at Station. Choose an interaction, follow its outcome, view the objective, then return to the menu. Unreal supplies the same event inputs from physical interactions and waits at the menu boundary. Keep one output per condition.

e1d06b05-73ac-4040-97d1-04a6f8091204.content:
START HERE · PLAY MODE AND UNREAL

The five labels set game_event.type and game_event.cell_id. All feed the same router. Unreal supplies these inputs itself and skips the menu labels. There is no separate simulation mode.

b7583d4b-fa40-4507-9057-7d2538281cc6.content:
TERMINAL · use_terminal

Accept the task once. Later visits show quest progress.

63297b78-e94e-4676-9e36-7dbdb9b02061.content:
GENERATOR · check_generator

Restore power after accepting the task and collecting enough cells. Then reach the exit.

567ce162-983d-43ba-b0d6-409dce845e18.content:
PICKUP · collect_cell

cell_id identifies cell_a or cell_b. Check its collected flag, then task acceptance. The accepted element marks the cell, increments inventory, and shows the new count. The collect_cell reference applies the physical Unreal effect afterward.

c2b03497-1971-4bd0-815e-1025fae44a13.content:
OBJECTIVES AND INTERFACE · SAME PLAYTHROUGH

Each interaction group uses a local jumper to this section. Reset quest_ui defaults, apply shared powered overrides when completed or powered, then select one of five objectives. Each objective returns to Station through its own jumper.

Unreal stops before this entry, refreshes it once, and stops before the menu. State lives in Player, Quest, Cell A, and Cell B; text remains in UI components. Use one Arcscript statement per code block.

8a1702ae-b5fe-44cb-bacd-97868065a17c.content:
EXIT · enter_exit

Entering the powered exit completes the task. Repeat entry only shows feedback.

quest.power_restored = true

show("The outpost is dark. Collect ", quest.required_power_cells, " power cells, then use the generator to restore the lights and open the exit gate.")
